Dolphins vs Patriots Betting History

The Miami Dolphins and New England Patriots have met 121 times since the 1966 season. The Dolphins lead the series 64-57. Against the closing spread the Dolphins are 60-57-4 (Patriots 57-60-4), and the over is 45-50-1 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Jan 4, 2026, Patriots 38-10.
